program.name: Calm Strength 35
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: Thirty-five calm minutes: core or Pilates, slow strength, then yin.
program.about: Calm strength in about half an hour. Upper days open with a core circuit and lift slowly for the chest, back and shoulders; lower days open with Pilates and lift slowly for the legs. Long yin holds close both. Level II slows every rep down and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Core, slow upper & yin / Pilates, slow lower & yin, 35 minutes
